senj-marriage-1736-12-matia-urolla-of-za: A MATIA UROLLA [URODA?] OF ZASTVA, A GROOM AT SENJ ON 2 DECEMBER 1736, marrying Jelena, daughter of a Jure R[…]ra of Klana; the surname is written «Urolla» (or «Vrolla») and the place Zastva is not identified. NOT shown to be any Uroda/Vroda of Karlobag or Šibenik
senj-marriage-1739-10-marko-tomicic-of-k: A MARKO TOMIČIĆ «OF KRMPOTE», A GROOM AT SENJ ON 13 OCTOBER 1739, marrying Lucia, daughter of a Sime Kerpula [?] — the earliest Krmpote groom met in the Senj marriage volume; Krmpote is the home of the Blažević side (row 33)
senj-marriage-1745-10-mihu-soyata-lucia-: A MIHU ŠOJAT [«SOYATA»], A GROOM AT SENJ ON 10 OCTOBER 1745, marrying Lucia, daughter of the late Luka Bevandić; witnesses Gergo Filipović and Boze Šojat — the Šojat surname of the families this archive holds
senj-marriage-1747-10-juretic-bakar-kata: A KATARINA PAPIĆ, DAUGHTER OF A MATIA PAPIĆ, A BRIDE AT SENJ ON 11 OCTOBER 1747, marrying Anton Juretić of Bakar; witnesses Jve Skukan and Matias Francetich. Not placed in the Papić family of the archive
senj-marriage-1765-pernich-of-krmpote-wi: A PERNICH [PRPIĆ?] OF KRMPOTE, A GROOM AT SENJ IN 1765, marrying the widow of a Vid Šojat; witnesses Francisko Vikentić and Matte Perqich — a Krmpote Prpić household and a Šojat widow, two surnames this archive researches
senj-marriage-1768-03-anna-widow-of-mate: AN ANNA, WIDOW OF THE LATE MATE BLAŽEVIĆ [«BLAXEVICH»], WHO MARRIED A GERGO [SOLAKICHEN?] AT SENJ IN MARCH 1768; witnesses Bartel Carich and Mate Skerich — a Blažević widow of Senj; her husband Mate is dead by 1768
senj-marriage-1769-01-mate-blazevic-marr: Mate Blažević of Senj groom of 1769
A MATE BLAŽEVIĆ [«BLAXEVICH»], A GROOM AT SENJ ON 23 JANUARY 1769, marrying a widow (her name and the place read «Gostone/Gostovo» are not legible at this size and need a closer read)
senj-marriage-1779-02-lorne-blazevic-fra: A LORNE [LORENZ?] BLAŽEVIĆ [«BLAXEVICH»], A GROOM AT SENJ IN FEBRUARY 1779, marrying a Franica [Fobber?]; witnesses Ivan Cerfich and Frane Rosich — the forename and the bride's surname are doubtful
senj-marriage-1783-06-juraj-oreskovic-ad: Juraj Orešković adjutant of the Otočac regiment

A JURAJ [GEORGIUS] OREŠKOVIĆ [«D' ORESKOVICH»], AN ADJUTANT OF THE OTOČAC REGIMENT, A GROOM AT SENJ ON 24 JUNE 1783, marrying a Catharina Milanes [?] — an Orešković officer, the surname of ahnentafel 21; his parents and place are not given
senj-marriage-1786-02-dube-sojat-widow-a: A DUBE [DUJE?] ŠOJAT [«SOJATA»], A GROOM AT SENJ IN FEBRUARY 1786, marrying a widow Antonia Bunić [«Bunich»]; witnesses Osip Ikovich and Jerolim Dora [?]
senj-marriage-1788-10-marko-salanic-anto: AN ANTONIA PRPIĆ [«PERPICH»], DAUGHTER OF A MATTE PRPIĆ, A BRIDE AT SENJ ON 9 OCTOBER 1788, marrying Marko Šalanić, son of Luka; witnesses Lieutenant Osip Baldsar and Anton Suppe. Not placed in the Prpić family of the archive
